title: Trade TARGETS🎯: 17 players to BUY or SELL before it's too late

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Trade TARGETS🎯: 17 players to BUY or SELL before it's too late
sources.description: Do you want to make a trade? Now is the time to do it during the fantasy season and Matt Harmon and Nate Tice are here to determine if 17 volatile players are buys or sells heading into Week 6. The two also provide a fantasy preview for the TNF matchup between the Seahawks and Broncos. Justin Boone then joins the show to discuss 8 players you should consider starting or sitting in your flex spots in Week 6.
